info.name: Galaxy Trouble Shooting API V23.07
info.description:
# galaxy-troubleshooting-api

使用Postman组件，基于Rest API接口对TSG OLAP 进行功能验证。包括组件健康检查，功能集成测试及故障诊断。

## Release 23.07 (21 JUL 2023)
###### Update
* 修复Network Throughput Active Sessions计算错误，不除时间粒度

## Release 23.06 (21 JUN 2023)
###### Update
* 优化Limit返回值

## Release 23.05 (28 MAY 2023)
###### New Features
* 增加Service chaining统计接口
* QGW增加嵌套子查询接口，用于验证高级搜索

###### Update
* Main Dashboard统计接口重构，更改统计源
* Live Traffic Chart 接口重构，更改统计源
* 原代理日志拆分为Intercept和Manipulation
* 相关Metrics的Schema更改为重构后的数据源


## Release 23.04 (28 APR 2023)
###### New Features
* 增加数据写入延迟接口Session Insert Latency Distribution
* 增加数据写入Kafka延迟接口 Session Ingestion Latency Distribution

###### Update
* 重构 Security Policy Hits Metrics 统计
* 重构 Traffic Shaping Metrics 统计

## Release 23.03 (28 MAR 2023)

###### New Features
* 目录整体重构，重新梳理功能，便于Newman CLI运行
* ClickHouse目录下增加慢查询故障诊断语句
* 参数与API接口统一改为英文，避免中文编码执行异常
* 加密环境变量密码、token等敏感信息
* 定义全局动态变量：时间范围、随机IP、随机域名等

###### Update

* Flags 添加C2S与S2C标志位标签


## Release 23.02 (28 FEB 2023)

###### New Features
* 增加Traffic Shaping 相关统计接口

###### Update
* 会话日志增加列common_shaping_rule_ids
* 会话与安全事件日志增加列common_server_domain
*会话与安全事件日志增加列common_flags_identify_info

## Release 23.01 (31 JAN 2023)
###### Update
* 会话与安全事件日志增加列common_server_fqdn
* 会话与安全事件日志增加列common_app_full_path


## Release 22.12 (30 DEC 2022)
###### New Features
* 新增Dashboards-增加App推荐
* 新增系统报告-会话日志Flags统计
* 新增系统报告-会话日志Flags占比

###### Update
* 会话与安全事件日志增加common_flags列
* 自定义IP映射-增加对ASN函数


## Release 22.1 (30 NOV 2022)
###### New Features

###### Update
* 会话与安全事件日志增加ssl_ja3s_hash列


## Release 22.10 (30 OCT 2022)
###### New Features
* 06其它-功能验证-Traffic Summary增加Throughput接口 
###### Update
* 更新原有查询，将VSYS ID作为默认查询条件

## Release 22.09 (30 SEP 2022)

###### Update
* 会话与安全事件日志增加common_tunnel_endpoint_a_desc, common_tunnel_endpoint_b_desc,dtls_sni 列

## Release 22.08 (31 AUG 2022)

###### New Features
* 其它-查询网关-Live Charts 总带宽流量校验
* 增加检查数据流-SQL执行计划

## Release 22.07 (30 JUL 2022)

###### New Features

###### Update

###### New Features

* Dashboards Top部分功能增加device_group, data_center维度校验


## Release 22.03 (8 APR 2022)

###### New Features
* 增加数据预处理检查，为每类日志增加多个测试用例，区分功能或无数据问题
###### Update
* 其它-评估日志预处理，增加ETL处理时延和写入Kafka时延指标

## Release 22.02 (8 MAR 2022)

## Release 22.01 (27 JAN 2022)

## Release 21.12 (1 Dec 2021)

###### New Features

*   新增数据推荐查询-实时查询任务
*   新增数据推荐查询-推荐Subscriber ID 到IP关系
*   新增数据推荐查询-推荐APP活跃客户端IP
*   新增数据推荐查询-推荐TopN Server IP
*   新增数据推荐查询-推荐TopN SNI

    *   自定义时间函数补全功能

###### Update

*   Dashboard 查询，代理策略命中动作增加Edit Element 统计
    

## Release 21.11 (5 Nov 2021)

###### New Features

*   Delete
*   Update
*   修改报告查询接口(由查询mariadb方式变更为API接口)
*   修改规范“数据推荐查询”所有接口的命名
    

## Release 21.10 (28 OCT 2021)

###### New Features

*   新增HOS健康状态检测接口
*   Delete
*   删除原ClickHouse/Druid/ArangoDB 状态检查接口
    

## Release 21.09 (23 SEP 2021)

###### New Features

*   Update
*   删除分布式调度任务，5分钟TOPN校验，交由FLink统计
*   原始日志表名进行重命名，相关查询接口更新
*   修正DNS分析的SQL数据集
    

## Release 21.08 (15 AUG 2021)

###### New Features

*   新增“Dashboard查询-DoS Threat Map”功能列表，显示DoS检测地图接口
*   新增“原始日志查询-DoS事件日志”，显示DoS攻击检测日志
*   新增“原始日志查询-DoS事件日志-Summary”，显示DoS攻击趋势统计
*   新增“原始日志查询-DoS事件日志-Destination IP Traffic Trend”，显示受害者IP历史流量趋势
*   Update
*   迁移“Dashboard查询”liveCharts接口，放到“Live Charts”目录中统一管理。
*   对DNS分析，增加一些查询样例
    

## Release 21.07 (5 JUL 2021)

###### New Features

*   增加”常用快捷功能-基数统计“，用于分析日志分布情况
*   增加”常用快捷功能-DNS放大攻击“，查询特征数据集
*   增加”通用检查-对象存储-获取某个文件“，用于文件获取验证
    

###### Update

*   为所有接口增加Tests脚本，对接口进行批量验证测试
*   修正部分接口查询异常
    

## Release 21.06 (7 JUN 2021)

###### New Features

*   Environments 增加环境变量domain、client_ip、server_ip、l7_protocol和PT1M_TIME
*   常用快捷功能增加某域名下钻、某IP下钻、协议下钻和DNS分析功能
    

###### Update

*   原始日志查询，基于Druid近1小时日志变化粒度从5分钟改为1分钟。包含通联、策略和代理日志。
    

## Release 21.05 (6 MAY 2021)

###### New Features

*   新增“GTP-C日志”功能，辅助故障诊断
*   新增“事务日志”功能，辅助故障诊断
*   新增“活跃会话日志”功能，辅助故障诊断
*   新增“07.常用快捷功能-评估写入日志量”，查看当前系统的吞吐
    

###### Update

*   修改"01.通用检查-数据存储检查"，增加事务、活跃及GTP-C 检测
    

## Release 21.04 (3 APR 2021)

###### New Features

*   增加“VoIP日志”功能，辅助故障诊断
*   增加“元数据检查”分类目录
*   增加“HOS对象存储”目录，用于定位对象存储
    

###### Update

*   修改“SQL语法检查”为“SQL语法验证”，支持SQL语句的静态分析和数据库语义验证
*   迁移功能项位置，方便问题定位
    

###### Delete

*   删除“系统检查-查询引擎SQL测试集\[过时\]”功能，由“故障诊断-sql性能测试”替代。
    

## Release 21.03 (2 MAR 2021)

###### New Features

*   增加故障诊断-元数据功能，可分析日志字段是否与schema一致
*   增加故障诊断-sql性能测试，可对查询引擎进行功能性验证和POC性能测试
    

###### Update

*   对查询引擎SQL测试集标记过时
    

## Release 21.02 (1 FEB 2021)

###### Update

*   改善内部测试集，应对新的功能修改
    

## Release 20.11.rc3 (11 DEC 2020)

###### New Features

*   增加常用快捷功能- 安装证书独立客户端IP数据趋势
*   增加常用快捷功能-访问速度最慢TOP20 域名
*   增加常用快捷功能-报告预置Metrics
*   增加原始日志查询-安全策略-动作命中计数
*   增加原始日志查询-代理策略-动作命中计数
*   增加原始日志查询-通联-流量计数(now)
    

###### Update

*   改善Dashboard查询-基础统计-新建、活跃（计数）-now
*   改善Dashboard查询-新建、活跃（趋势）
*   目录增加编号，便于管理
*   修改分布式调度任务-5分钟TOPN-hot表验证表名
*   部分Action为post 改为 get，便于导出命令行

request.description: 验证原始日志是否有最新的数据

url.raw:
http://{{qgw_ip}}:{{qgw_port}}?query=select  'Session Record' as type, round(count(*)/300,0) as "logs/sec", round(avg(common_processing_time-common_ingestion_time),2) as "avg_etl_latency(s)", round(avg(common_ingestion_time-common_end_time),2) as "avg_ingestion_latency(s)"
from
	session_record crl 
where
	common_recv_time >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP({{Last 5 Minutes Start}})
	and common_recv_time < UNIX_TIMESTAMP({{now}}) union all select  'Interim Session Record' as type, round(count(*)/300,0) as "logs/sec", round(avg(common_processing_time-common_ingestion_time),2) as "avg_etl_latency(s)", round(avg(common_ingestion_time-common_end_time),2) as "avg_ingestion_latency(s)"
from
	interim_session_record crl 
where
	common_recv_time >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP({{Last 5 Minutes Start}})
	and common_recv_time < UNIX_TIMESTAMP({{now}}) union all select  'Transaction Record' as type, round(count(*)/300,0) as "logs/sec", round(avg(common_processing_time-common_ingestion_time),2) as "etl_latency(s)" , round(avg(common_ingestion_time-common_end_time),2) as "avg_ingestion_latency(s)"
	from transaction_record crl 
where
	common_recv_time >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP({{Last 5 Minutes Start}})
	and common_recv_time < UNIX_TIMESTAMP({{now}}) union all select  'Security Event' as type, round(count(*)/300,0) as "logs/sec", round(avg(common_processing_time-common_ingestion_time),2) as "avg_etl_latency(s)", round(avg(common_ingestion_time-common_end_time),2) as "avg_ingestion_latency(s)"
from
	security_event crl 
where
	common_recv_time >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP({{Last 5 Minutes Start}})
	and common_recv_time < UNIX_TIMESTAMP({{now}})
union all select  'Proxy Event' as type, round(count(*)/300,0) as "logs/sec", round(avg(common_processing_time-common_ingestion_time),2) as "avg_etl_latency(s)", round(avg(common_ingestion_time-common_end_time),2) as "avg_ingestion_latency(s)"
from
	proxy_event crl 
where
	common_recv_time >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP({{Last 5 Minutes Start}})
	and common_recv_time < UNIX_TIMESTAMP({{now}})
 union all select  'Radius Record' as type, round(count(*)/300,0) as "logs/sec", round(avg(common_processing_time-common_ingestion_time),2) as "avg_etl_latency(s)", round(avg(common_ingestion_time-common_end_time),2) as "avg_ingestion_latency(s)"
from
	radius_record crl 
where
	common_recv_time >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP({{Last 5 Minutes Start}})
	and common_recv_time < UNIX_TIMESTAMP({{now}}) union all select  'gtpc_record' as type, round(count(*)/300,0) as "logs/sec",round(avg(common_processing_time-common_ingestion_time),2) as "avg_etl_latency(s)", round(avg(common_processing_time-common_ingestion_time),2) as "avg_etl_latency(s)"
from
	gtpc_record crl 
where
	common_recv_time >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP({{Last 5 Minutes Start}})
	and common_recv_time < UNIX_TIMESTAMP({{now}})

request.description: 验证Apache Druid 统计表是否有最新的数据

item.description:
# Dashboard 业务

Dashboard 为预聚合计数操作，接入数据源有四处（KAFKA TOPIC）：

* TRAFFIC-METRICS-LOG ： 功能端5秒输出一次
* CONNECTION-RECORD-COMPLETE-LOG: 数据平台接收CONNECTION-RECORD-LOG 补全后实时输出。
* PROXY/SECURITY-EVENT-COMPLETE-LOG: 数据平台接收PROXY/SECURITY 命中策略日志补全后实时输出。

## 流量计数Metrics 

**功能端 - Kafka（TRAFFIC-METRICS-LOG 每5秒 ) - Druid** 

所有基础Metrics（非内容级别的统计）都为功能端提前预聚合输出到TRAFFIC-METRICS-LOG 中，最终数据平台写入Druid 中，供API查询。具体包含：

* System Overview （Traffic 、New、Live）
* Policy Hits by Action(Security)
* Policy Hits by Action (proxy) 、Pinning

## TOPN 计算

**流程1：功能端 - Kafka（原始日志） - 补全 - Druid**  // 统计安全策略与代理策略结果，每1分钟

**流程2：功能端 - Kafka（原始日志） - 补全 -  Druid - 调度任务 - kafka -Druid ** // TOPN 计算，每5分钟

所有内容级别，为数据平台进行实时统计，将指标输出到Druid中，供API进行查询。具体包含：

* Top Hits (security) - 流程1

* Top Hits (proxy) - 流程1

* Endpoints (Active Client/Server/Internal/External , Top Domains, Active Subscriber ID,Top urls) - 流程2

	GROUP BY
		"SSL.SNI")
ORDER BY
	"Sessions" DESC,
	"Client IP" DESC,
	"Server IP" DESC

	sum(total_in_bytes) as total_in_bytes,
	sum(total_out_bytes) as total_out_bytes,

	max(total_out_bytes) as max_out_bytes,
	min(total_in_bytes) as min_in_bytes,
	avg(total_in_bytes) as avg_in_bytes,
	avg(total_out_bytes) as avg_out_bytes

		sum(total_in_bytes) as total_in_bytes,
		sum(total_out_bytes) as total_out_bytes,
		sum(total_in_bytes + total_out_bytes) as total_all_bytes,
		sum(total_in_packets) as total_in_packets,
		sum(total_out_packets) as total_out_packets,
		sum(total_in_packets + total_out_packets) as total_all_packets,
		sum(new_conn_num) as sessions
	from
		traffic_metrics_log
	where
		__time >= '2022-01-01 00:00:00'
	group by TIME_FLOOR_WITH_FILL(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(__time),'PT1S') )
group by
	TIME_FLOOR_WITH_FILL(statisticsTime,'PT1H','zero')
order by stat_time asc
